title: Michigan shooting: 5 killed, 1 critically injured, gunman found dead after manhunt
summary_full: Five people died in a northern Michigan shooting on Friday. The suspected gunman was later found dead after a large search. One other person sustained critical injuries and was hospitalized. Investigators discovered a fourth victim at another residence during the extensive search. The circumstances surrounding the deaths and the motive remain under investigation.
